help.quality_selector: Choose the video quality. 4K takes longer and needs more storage. Use 'video_fast' for a quicker download.
help.batch_download: Download many videos at once from a channel or playlist. Up to 10 videos per batch to avoid being blocked.
help.schedule: Schedule automatic downloads with a cron expression. Example: '0 9 * * *' = every day at 9 AM.
help.archive_pin: Pin a video to the archive so it isn't deleted after 24 hours. The file is kept permanently (until you delete it).
help.remove_watermark: Remove the watermark with AI inpainting. TikTok/Douyin only. Takes an extra 30–60 seconds to process.
help.webhook: Get notified through your webhook URL when a download finishes. We send a POST request with the job details.
help.approval_workflow: Large-scale downloads need approval from a workspace admin before they run. You'll be notified once approved.
help.auto_retry: The system retries automatically on temporary errors (rate limit, timeout), up to 3–4 times with backoff.
